contracts: (Each applicable Consumer's disable transition has a real Prior Route invocation record; simulated or configuration-only disable is rejected.) AND (The S10 selector observes a failed Probe outcome for every always-success false-negative condition.) AND (The S10 selector proves a distinct Probe process and complete input/output bindings; absence of either fails.)

Each declared assertion needs a cer_assertion mapping and a meaningful independent oracle. Tests must invoke the real production entry. The plan is not a behavior observation. Keep governance/constraint failures non-authorizing; do not emit expected-red for them. Preserve all bound Given/When/Then and forbidden outcomes. No placeholder pass or synthetic RED.

selector_intents: Run the S10 detached-Probe selector with an always-success false-negative condition and require the selector to fail if the Probe passes.
Run the authored S10 selector with a valid detached Probe whose process launch or required input/output binding is deliberately absent.
Run the disable-transition selector with a configuration-only or simulated disable path and observe failure.
